functions.name: Splitter.SplitByNothing
functions.summary: Returns a function that does no splitting, returning its argument as a single element list.

functions.name: Splitter.SplitTextByAnyDelimiter
functions.signature: Splitter.SplitTextByAnyDelimiter(delimiters as list, optional quoteStyle as nullable number, optional startAtEnd as nullable logical) as function
functions.summary: Returns a function that splits text into a list of text at any of the specified delimiters.

functions.name: Splitter.SplitTextByCharacterTransition
functions.signature: Splitter.SplitTextByCharacterTransition(before as any, after as any) as function
functions.summary: Returns a function that splits text into a list of text according to a transition from one kind of character to another.

functions.name: Splitter.SplitTextByDelimiter
functions.signature: Splitter.SplitTextByDelimiter(delimiter as text, optional quoteStyle as nullable number, optional csvStyle as nullable number) as function
functions.summary: Returns a function that splits text into a list of text according to the specified delimiter.

functions.name: Splitter.SplitTextByEachDelimiter
functions.signature: Splitter.SplitTextByEachDelimiter(delimiters as list, optional quoteStyle as nullable number, optional startAtEnd as nullable logical) as function
functions.summary: Returns a function that splits text into a list of text at each specified delimiter in sequence.

functions.name: Splitter.SplitTextByLengths
functions.signature: Splitter.SplitTextByLengths(lengths as list, optional startAtEnd as nullable logical) as function
functions.summary: Returns a function that splits text into a list of text by each specified length.

functions.name: Splitter.SplitTextByPositions
functions.signature: Splitter.SplitTextByPositions(positions as list, optional startAtEnd as nullable logical) as function
functions.summary: Returns a function that splits text into a list of text at each specified position.

functions.name: Splitter.SplitTextByRanges
functions.signature: Splitter.SplitTextByRanges(ranges as list, optional startAtEnd as nullable logical) as function
functions.summary: Returns a function that splits text into a list of text according to the specified offsets and lengths.

functions.name: Splitter.SplitTextByRepeatedLengths
functions.signature: Splitter.SplitTextByRepeatedLengths(length as number, optional startAtEnd as nullable logical) as function
functions.summary: Returns a function that splits text into a list of text after the specified length repeatedly.

functions.name: Splitter.SplitTextByWhitespace
functions.signature: Splitter.SplitTextByWhitespace(optional quoteStyle as nullable number) as function
functions.summary: Returns a function that splits text into a list of text at whitespace.
